ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity white patches on the distal portions; estimated 75% dark to 25% white distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the inner surface area with irregular, high-contrast white mottling and patches concentrated on the outer lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a sharp convergence point at the central pixel axis dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, showing increased frequency towards the outer distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips, which are sharply angled upwards relative to the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular and polygonal barnacle structures located along the distal edges and extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous light-colored linear streaks and vertical rake marks visible against the dark pigmented surface across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on the distal margins of the fluke lobes.
